## CredentialProviderEIP712 class

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.

A Veramo Credential sub-plugin that implements a [ICredentialProvider](./credential-w3c.icredentialprovider.md) with support for EthereumEIP712Signature2021 proofs.

This API may change without a BREAKING CHANGE notice.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class CredentialProviderEIP712 implements ICredentialProvider
```

**Implements:** [ICredentialProvider](./credential-w3c.icredentialprovider.md)
